prompt: Create a photorealistic waist-up outdoor portrait of a young East Asian woman, early 20s, with a natural gentle expression, looking directly into the camera. She has medium chestnut-brown shoulder-length hair with soft layers and wispy straight bangs, warm brown eyes, smooth natural makeup, and slightly parted lips. She is wearing a clean white lightweight hooded sweatshirt with drawstrings; show the hoodie fabric realistically with subtle folds, seams, sleeves, and soft shadows. Pose her standing at a slight angle with relaxed shoulders, hands lightly gathered near the lower right edge of the frame, upper torso visible. Use bright natural daylight with soft backlighting and rim light through her hair, creating a fresh candid city-street feeling. The background should be heavily blurred with shallow depth of field: dark vertical architectural columns or railings, circular white bokeh highlights, and a few small warm yellow/orange blurred lights. Use realistic skin texture, natural proportions, corrected hands and fingers, high-resolution DSLR portrait quality, 85mm lens look, f/1.8 bokeh, soft contrast, clean color grading, no text, no watermark, no extra people, no exaggerated glamour styling.

promptZh: 创作一张照片级写实的户外人像，主体为 年轻东亚女性，置于柔和的日光下，采用 4:5 竖构图，取景范围从躯干中部向上。她拥有 中等长度栗棕色齐肩发，带有柔和的层次感和轻盈的直刘海，妆容自然，皮肤通透，棕色大眼睛，直视镜头时带着轻松温柔的浅笑。她身穿 纯色浅灰白色修身连帽衫，带有抽绳；可见的服装细节包括：连帽、两条抽绳、长袖以及平整的修身衣身。她的双手在画面右下角边缘轻微交叠，部分被裁剪。使用浅景深效果，背景为模糊的城市景观，包含深色垂直立柱和明亮的圆形光斑，右上方的暖色轮廓光照亮发丝，面部和连帽衫上有柔和的自然阴影，皮肤纹理真实，织物褶皱自然，呈现高分辨率单反人像质感，具备 85mm 镜头感，自然色彩分级，无文字，无水印，无额外人物。
